title: Character, Creature, Token, Portrait & Cast Presentation Binding
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast Presentation Binding over the MAS-01..11 foundations while preserving canonical Character/Creature, MCCS/entity-presentation, token/portrait/media and runtime owner authority and keeping presentation bindings distinct from canonical entity or live runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast Presentation bindings inside the MAS workspace without turning presentation bindings into canonical entity, media, token or live runtime mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically bind prepared Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast presentation references over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating presentation bindings as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-11, including current MSLR planning, and unlocks no new cross-program rotation at this milestone; MAS strict-order continuation therefore selects MAS-12.
This checkpoint selects MAS-12 only; it does not grant implementation authority.
No MAS-12 implementation branch exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts MAS-12.
MAS-01 through MAS-11 remain completed foundations and are not reopened silently.

The MAS prepared-presentation-vs-live doctrine remains controlling: Character, Creature, Token, Portrait or Cast presentation bindings do not by themselves mutate canonical Character/Creature identity or state, MCCS/entity-presentation state, token/portrait/media resources or runtime truth.

Detailed MAS-12 Character/Creature, MCCS/entity-presentation, token/portrait/media and runtime owner seams and binding mechanics are intentionally deferred to governed start and targeted dependency loading rather than invented at selection time.
MAS-13 retains Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts & Player Artifact Authoring scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-13+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start MAS-12; do not implement while selected_not_started.
